modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Turn the parts of Olivares this installation runs on or off. Apply restarts the engine once to take the change, and the restart stops the running sessions.

restartWarning.title: Restart the engine?
restartWarning.stop_one: {{count}} running session stops. It can be resumed after the restart.
restartWarning.stop_other: {{count}} running sessions stop. Each one can be resumed after the restart.
restartWarning.unknown: Every running session stops. Each one can be resumed after the restart.

modules.unavailable: Modules cannot be chosen on this engine.

modules.noChanges: No changes to apply. Turn a module on or off first.
modules.whenOffDefault: Its data is kept, but nothing uses it while the module is off.

whenOff.siemforward: Audit events are no longer forwarded to your SIEM.
whenOff.inferenceproxy: Model calls no longer pass through the gateway.
whenOff.knowledge: Knowledge is no longer served to agents.
whenOff.sourcescope: Source limits are no longer applied.
whenOff.claude-policy: Managed Claude Code settings are no longer checked.

signing.title: Report signing
signing.description: Evidence bundles downloaded from Reports are signed with this installation’s Ed25519 key, so an auditor can check that nobody changed them.
signing.subject: report signing

state.notReady: Downloaded bundles are not signed yet: {{reason}}.

signing.offKeepsKey: Turning it off keeps the key, so bundles signed before can still be verified.

tracing.description: Export traces and metrics to your collector. Changes apply without restarting the engine.
tracing.insecure: Allow plaintext on a trusted network
tracing.businessRequired: SIEM delivery and external telemetry export require Business. Stored settings are preserved; Community does not send them.

signIn.noSso: No single sign-on provider is available on the sign-in page.
signIn.sessionHint: The engine sets this lifetime at sign-in and renews it when the session is refreshed. It is not configurable.
signIn.passwordBlocked: Single sign-on is required. Local password sign-in is blocked.
signIn.ssoNotEnforced: Single sign-on is requested, but this build does not enforce that policy. Check the identity provider settings before signing out.
signIn.passwordManaged: Your organization administrator manages password sign-in.
signIn.ssoInactive: Single sign-on is requested, but its identity provider is inactive. This requirement does not block password sign-in.

sessionIdle.description: Off by default. Free memory by stopping finished sessions that are no longer open. Resume keeps the folder and conversation.
sessionIdle.hint: Use 0 to turn off, or 6–10080 minutes. The idle window begins after five minutes without output. Sessions with approvals, running children or peers, or a newer message stay running.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: The version this engine runs, the newest signed release in its channel, and one action to install it. The engine verifies the release, replaces its binary and restarts once; the restart stops the running sessions.
updates.stillRestarting: The engine has not come back on the new version yet. Reload this page in a minute to check.
updates.unavailable: Updates cannot be installed from the console on this engine. Run olivares upgrade on the server.
updates.loadFailed: The update status could not be read. Try again.

confirm.title: Update to {{version}}?
confirm.stop_one: {{count}} running session stops. It can be resumed after the restart.
confirm.stop_other: {{count}} running sessions stop. Each one can be resumed after the restart.
confirm.none: The engine restarts once on the new version.
confirm.switchNone: The engine restarts once on the licensed edition. Your data stays where it is.

updates.alreadyCurrent: Already on the newest release. Nothing was installed.
updates.restartRequired: A newer version is installed. Restart the engine with its service manager to run it.
updates.terminal: Same thing in a terminal on the server
updates.orTerminal: Or in a terminal on the server
